market_overview: Across the evidence packet, sentiment is mixed but leans toward bullish in several asset classes. AI & Technology, Oil, U.S. Equities, Gold, Bitcoin and Oil all show bullish consensus despite some conflicting coverage, while Interest Rates, Inflation and the U.S. Dollar remain mixed or bearish. The global PSI is neutral (56) with US and Europe also neutral, indicating no strong directional tilt. Top movers such as Solana and Coinbase illustrate volatility in crypto and fintech, aligning with the broader bullish tilt in AI‑related themes but contrasting with the dollar’s bearish bias.
